Annotated Codex Conversation (Including Model "Thoughts"):

Summary: 

I used codex on the coding portion of HW3, and it was able to essentially much one-shot the problems. However, I first prompted it without actually asking it to run the code, so the conceptual answers lacked detail, though the entirety of the code was correct. 

I proceeded to allow Codex to access and run the code, examine the resulting figures, and revise its answers. After this, all answers were correct and good.
